title: Restructure Engineer's Notebook
question: Second hand, steered: the demo stays in its own box, Given/Find carries the working, and the first version's reference content comes back. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Formula, then worked example
options.thesis: The formula and the demo box open the page together; a Given/Find worked example runs underneath on your demo values.
options.viewport: Left: title, one line, ruled formula and symbols. Right: the full demo box from version one. Below: Given, Find, Solution, Answer, then other load cases as their own small section.
options.risk: Closest to version one; the worked example must not feel like an appendix.

options.label: Labelled sheet
options.thesis: One labelled gutter runs the whole page: Given, Sketch, Solution, Answer, Reference, with the demo box spanning the Sketch row.
options.viewport: Gutter labels on the left. Given as a compact value table, then the demo box across the full width, then Solution with numbers substituted, boxed answer, and a Reference row with cases and symbols.
options.risk: Long on scroll; the demo sits below Given rather than in the first glance.

options.label: Quick reference + example
options.thesis: A one-line reference strip for formula-grabbers on top; below it, Given sits beside the demo box and the solution follows.
options.viewport: Title, then a ruled strip holding the formula, symbols and units in one row. Then Given (editable values) left, demo box right, Solution and boxed Answer under both.
options.risk: The strip gets crowded on topics with many symbols.
